comparison.objective: Selects and installs the matching driver bit, power-tightens a drawer knob, and returns the tool; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1288 requires bit-shape selection, bit insertion, powered screw engagement, workpiece stabilization, and tool parking; the candidate requires manual two-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1288 checks mounted-bit identity, powered axial screw feed, knob closure, a 5 N hold test, motor-off release, and tool return; the candidate checks retained angular opening and cycling.
comparison.reason: Powered fastening after bit selection is a different tested ability from adjusting a screw setpoint and preventing its rotation during jam-nut locking.
